units: all named byte fields are bytes; ingress offsets are plugin metadata-binding PCM ingress bytes, not source-file offsets or HW frames
accepted_cursor: increments only valid actual positive Write return within requested range; ingress cursor separately counts actual received buffers
wire: qap505v1:<14 canonical U64 fields separated by colon>:<SHA256 lower hex digest or empty unknown>
privacy: No raw source or PCM samples in descriptor/logs. Bounded first128-byte SHA256 is only a diagnostic content sample, never a source-to-decoded-frame proof.
generation: Process native monotonically increasing saturating U64 ID, joined with source PID and /proc/self/stat birth ticks (zero unknown). Never DSP SyncID.
boundaries: Cache slices retain original generation/ingress offsets and native cache_id across partial writes; reset/seek/flush retires provenance; old cached slices remain explicitly old_generation. Observation cap emits unknown observation_limit.
session_timing: renderer_session/query fields are immutable metadata-consumption binding. Each write row separately records actual immediately-before-Write GetAudioStreamId result; a late successful query never retroactively proves old source/frame mapping.
binding_identity: receiver PID/birth + plugin_instance + metadata_binding_instance qualifies ingress offsets. Initial metadata query/session change creates a new native binding and cursor; cached slices retain old binding. old_generation means retired immutable binding (not numerical source_generation ordering).
private_relay_route: Late updates are exactly one private KEY with string value. Two relays inspect begin/end exactly-one-key shape; forward without changing globalMeta, app identity, time range or ordinary plugin setters. Wrong type/no sink/no plugin stays unknown/pending; ordinary multi-key Meta always follows original body.
